# Bucksworth Home Services

> Family-owned pest control, HVAC, plumbing, and home services company serving Phoenix and Tucson, Arizona since 2013.

Bucksworth Home Services was founded by Jordan and Taylor Moore in 2013 and provides residential pest control, HVAC/air conditioning, plumbing, insulation, and weed control services across 34 cities in the Phoenix metro and Tucson areas.

## Services

- Pest & Termite Control (scorpions, termites, rodents, spiders, ants, roaches, bed bugs, bees, mosquitoes, snakes, and more)
- Weed Control (pre-emergent, post-emergent, rock yard treatments)
- HVAC / Air Conditioning (repair, installation, maintenance, mini-splits, heat pumps, furnaces, duct work, air quality)
- Plumbing (water heaters, tankless, drain cleaning, slab leak repair, gas lines, repiping, water filtration)
- Insulation (blow-in, pest guard, duct insulation, attic insulation)

## Service Areas

### Phoenix Branch — (480) 422-8388
Ahwatukee, Anthem, Apache Junction, Buckeye, Casa Grande, Chandler, Coolidge, Florence, Fountain Hills, Gilbert, Glendale, Gold Canyon, Goodyear, Laveen, Litchfield Park, Maricopa, Mesa, Paradise Valley, Peoria, Phoenix, Queen Creek, San Tan Valley, Scottsdale, Surprise, Tempe

### Tucson Branch — (520) 284-9930
Catalina Foothills, Green Valley, Marana, Oro Valley, Red Rock, Sahuarita, Tucson, Vail, Valencia West

Note: Tucson branch provides pest control and weed control services only. Phoenix branch provides all service verticals.

## Pricing

- Gold Pest Plan: $39/month (foundation perimeter, doors & windows, cobweb removal, free re-services)
- Platinum Pest Plan: $49/month (Gold + curb-to-fenceline, sidewalk & driveway, wall injections, defense dust)
- Termite Protection Add-On: $29/month
- Mosquito Control Add-On: $89/month
- 3-year price guarantee on all plans
- Free termite inspections for existing customers
